name: rebellion
author: BlaXun
description: Rebellion in pre-renewal. A Gunslinger at 99/70 is reborn as a Novice, becomes a Gunslinger again with transcendent stat points, and from Gunslinger job 50 becomes a Rebellion. The skills are scaled to sit a little below the transcendent classes, and four tiers of Rebellion guns and gear (levels 50 to 95) drop from monsters.
